comments: Maha was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to our needs/requests. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful. The property is absolutely clean and stylish. It is exactly the same as shown in the pictures. We could not have asked for a better location. Overall a wonderful place; we would stay here again easily! We were delighted to find such a modern and clean space right near where we wanted to be. It was the perfect place for us to stay and such a great value. Thank you so much Maha.

Beautiful property. We are so glad he offered us this outstanding option. Very spacious, good view, walkable, close to anywhere, very convenient, clean and tidy. It was the hardest goodbye :’) They are highly recommended hosts. Very responsive in communication. Will definitely come back here.

that area has really nice restaurants and good mart. and very close to tram. the place itself was nice, clean and beautiful. and they have every appliances we needed. I definitely want to book here again when I come back to Melbourne. 100% recommend!
Great location, transport at door. Easy walk to river, casino and DFO shops. Unfortunately they were doing road works overnight so a little noisy. Would definitely stay again, good value.
Our stay was incredible. Our host was helpful and friendly. She went above and beyond for us. We will definitely be back.

Beautiful apartment across the street from the beach - very comfortable for a family of four and walking distance to dozens of restaurants. Also close to the tram so getting into Melbourne on public transport is super easy.

the place was well furnished and equipped with all the essentials! great view from the 68th floor too. walkable to many places and very near queen victoria market. had a good and comfortable stay overall!

Great location! Nicole was also easily accessible and very helpful when we had an issue with the parking permit. Great place for 4 people. Don't recommend 6 staying though as the sofa bed is not very comfortable. We could feel the springs though the thin matteress. There was only one roll of toilet paper for 6 girls so we had to buy own own, but this would be easy for the host to fix.

Jun’s place was exactly as pictured online. It was in the best location and had everything we needed. Jun was also really easy to communicate with. Super quick responses and she even offered us late check out. The stay was amazing!
Great location & clean. Bit smaller than I thought but fine for 2 adults & 2 kids. Nicole was great & really helpful
Jun is a very nice and reactive host. The apartment is right in the CBD with a garage, very important if you are travelling with a car!

I stayed here for 3 days. This a quiet and artistic neighborhood, and the accommodation that Sean provided is so clean and comfortable. Plus traffic here is also super convenient and near the city area. If I were to visit Melbourne next time, I’ll definitely settle here again!
Audrey and Willem’s place is lovely. Stylish and tidy, in a convenient location for travel in and around Melbourne.

I booked this gorgeous cottage only 3 weeks before my wedding after a hellious experience with our previously booked accomodation. Which I am now so happy it did fell through as I feel i found a 4 leaf cover. I had the most wonderful 2 nights and the most beautiful wedding photos there. Very relaxing. Roslyn went above and beyond and replied to all my messages within minutes. Thanks for saving my wedding!
Superb location in Chelsea close to shops, beaches and walking trails. Beautiful bedroom with bathroom draws with thoughtful extras so very welcoming.

The property is a credit to Kylie. It made our stay in Melbourne pleasurable knowing that at end of our activities we were returning to a residence where we could relax with all the comforts of home and more. The residence was spotless, well appointed, with extremely comfortable beds. We have no hesitation in recommending Kylie’s residence. Kylie was obliging, helpful and pleasure to deal with.

Loved our stay at Lisa's place. The apartment was very clean and well stocked with all the essentials which we appreciated greatly. Beds were comfortable and the apartment was in a great location. We had a few issues accessing the apartment initially as an external company is used to provide access. However, Lisa helped to get this resolved fairly quickly. Aside from this it was a great stay.
Awesome apartment, well fitted out and very comfortable. Perfect location, no noise from outside but still right in the heart of South Yarra.
Fantastic place to stay in Melbourne CBD. All comforts of home in an amazing location. Would recommend Kim and this place for sure! Great responsive and knowledgeable host!

This Airbnb is in a really charming building. The apartment was very pleasant and I felt right at home. There some very thoughtful snacks left which was very touching. Great neighbourhood and environment. A quick walk to a number of eateries and shopping, in fact some within just 100 m. No need for a car to get places and do stuff which I really loved. There isn't a lot of natural light on the upper floor (it was winter), but the lighting made up for it. Highly recommend the place. I had a very pleasant stay.

I had an amazing stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and in a great location. The host was very responsive and made sure everything was perfect for my visit. The check-in process was seamless, and I felt right at home. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Would definitely come back! Thank you so much James!

Great location, secure, clean and very comfortable. There were a few glitches with communication as there was no house manual, I had problems using the fob on doors/garage etc and I find having to message a host for clarity and answers annoying but thats me! Otherwise the place was excellent and is cozy and warm in the afternoon with the sun and the heating works very well.

From the moment we entered we felt at home. We arrived late as flights were delayed and the welcome goodies were truly appreciated. Such a nice place, well appointed and well kept. We really enjoyed the area, tree lined streets along with great cafe & restaurants close by.

We had a pleasant stay at this apartment. The location was fantastic, close to many amenities and attractions. The apartment itself was clean, spacious, and well-equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The host was very responsive and accommodating. However, one minor issue we encountered was that the blinds were not blackout blinds, which made it difficult to completely darken the room. This was a bit challenging for us as we were traveling with a baby who needed a darker room to sleep.

This place was excellent! Very modern and updated, exactly as described in the listing. Very very clean and many extra special touches like fresh milk in the fridge, extra towels, high end shampoo/conditioner/soap, laundry and dish soap, and even an adorable crib set up for my youngest. The location was great, steps from groceries and a park and a short drive into central Melbourne.

Kayhan’s house became our home away from home for over a month while we were staying as a family, in Melbourne. Kayhan was very helpful and proactive, friendly and accomodating, and let our dog stay too. The house is very comfortable, and has all the needed amenities/appliances. It is in a great location- with public transport right outside and many parks in short walking distance. Nestled between Kew, Camberwell, Balwyn- everything is conveniently at your doorstep. We really loved our time here- and if you’re a family, it’s a great place to be based and explore.

Sparsely furnished with cheap basics. Huge heavy main bed. No space to move around . We stubbed our shins and toes several times! Mismatched Crockery was mostly cracked and well worn. Eg only 3 mugs of which 2 were cracked. No juice glasses or tumblers. It reminded us of Backpacker hostels. I washed 2 entire pillows (took 3 days to dry out) and pillow protectors.
Our family had a lovely and comfortable stay at Simone’s apartment . . it was well appointed and close to transport and located in a leafy and quiet street!

Amazing beautiful house. Very clean, roomy bedrooms excellent location. Coles was a minute walk. Restaurants and train station 10 mins walk. 20mins car ride to Melbourne CBD. Absolutely loved the place. Will be back again.

Great view overlooking the valleys and mountains. Inside has spacious living and dining areas and s lovely old world feel as per the photos which suits the property. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.

We really loved our stay. The location was very ideal, super close to the beach. Check in was very easy too. The aircon was very much appreciated and the general space was really nice. Additionally, comms with Paolo was a breeze. Highly recommended stay!
We really enjoyed staying at Fiona‘s place. Close to the Buzzy shops and market but quiet at night. Nicely decorated with a brilliant art collection.

Sam’s place is strategically located inside the free tram zone and have many things to do around it. The apartment was definitely enough for 4 adults. It’s so easy to go around, many restaurants and shops. Sam is very helpful and provides detailed information so check in and check out was a breeze. Had a lovely time. Thank you!

Frank and Pam were extremely friendly and prompt in their responses. Thank you for responding so quickly and accommodating to our last minute asks. We’re extremely grateful to have met such understanding hosts and their place is really clean and beautiful, exactly like the pics! Hopefully their place is available the next time we visit coz we’d sure like to stay again!
Beautiful place with so many extra special touches. Beautifully decorated and very comfortable. Kylie was an excellent host. We loved our stay. Thank you.
The place was as described and clean. It had everything to make our stay was very comfortable. The location was very central and convenient.
As we were guests at a wedding with an early start Grace was very accommodating. Very cosy and comfortable . Thankyou Grace
Property was very felt homely. Mostly we enjoyed playing piano. Griselda has been very flexible with check in and check out times which was very helpful.

We had an amazing stay at Sam’s place! Everything was exactly as described, clean, and incredibly comfortable. Sam was a fantastic host: responsive, thoughtful, and made the check-in process super easy. The location was great and had everything we needed nearby. Would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. Thanks again, Sam!

Beautiful , aesthetically pleasing well appointed apartment. Quality linen , utensils in kitchen and other amenities.Close to public transport and short drive to CBD.loved our stay . Would love to stay again . Anna’ s communication was excellent .

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Wonderful stay at Justin's place! The three of us had a comfortable stay at Justin's place. The two double bedrooms were spacious and clean, and the kitchen and living space was very clean and comfortable. The place was kitted out with all the things you'd need for a comfortable stay using the kitchen as much as you'd like. Right by the beach, and close to multiple transport links into the city centre. Helpful and very responsive hosts! Would definitely stay again!

Anna was very kind and helpful during my stay. The place is a very cute small area that is clean and comfortable with everything you need. A great bathroom and the most comfortable bed. The noise from the roads nearby was decently loud for myself personally but nothing some earplugs couldn’t fix and the amazing space and comfy bed couldn’t make up for. The location was very nice and could get everywhere by tram. Would definitely stay again!

Loved Jo’s place! She was friendly, and proactive, without being overbearing. The space was clean and well maintained. The heaters in the bedrooms were also much appreciated. Easy check-in, easy stay.

A really great stay, so easy with the Tram stop right outside, awesome wine bar & restaurant right across the road. Very quiet and super light, warm and airy apartment with great energy & flow out to the view.
Great location for us. Thank you for a great stay. The only problem was the garage was too small for our hired car. 🚗

Had a wonderful few days here, 2 comfortable beds, washing machine, living space, and decked-out kitchen in the centre of Melbourne. Easy to get out and about, as well as back home at the end of the day. Highly recommended!

Michelle kindly answered my last minute request for a long-term stay in minutes. She took the time to great me and gave me plenty of recommendations on places to eat, drink and ways to enjoy Melbourne as she is the 'ultimate Melbourne guide' to discover this amazing city. This is the perfect city loft experience with access from a typical Melbourne lane. Very well situated, with a unique caracter and soul, spacious and peaceful. You wish this was your home! Many thanks Michelle.
Allan was an amazing host , nothing was to much trouble for him, and they were very hospitable. All our needs were meet 100%. Cant wait to stay again was over all fantastic .
Brigitte's cottage is superb and the extra treats such as scones, cakes, truffles and fruit were delicious. Look forward to returning.
Mystical, semi-rural accommodation in the hills amongst genuine, hospitable mountain people. Recommended for families and those looking to get away from the banalities of every day life.
A fabulous apartment - and such an amazing location in Degraves Lane. If you want to be right in the city action - which we did - it is perfect.

Lovely place, vera beautiful tree filled and green area, a perfect place to calm down, relax, enjoy the awesome creation around. Olinda is a pretty quiet little village whrer you find everything you need for daily living, some nice cafes around - esp. the Ranges, very good fihn chips at the Fish cafe. Greater supermarkets ins Monbulk. Robyns and Ken#s house is a lovely place, they are very kind and considered guests and made sure that I felt at home, offering pick up at my arrival in Olinda and on my way back Barbare even took me down to the next train station. Everything is available that you might need for cooking, just bare in mind that a kitchenette does not replace a fully equipped kitchen. You do have one hot plate, a microwave and a ricecooker to your disposal.

Such a sweet little place like this hardly seems imaginable that it’s only 2.4 m x 5 m in size. A bit like Doctor Who’s tardis it seems a lot bigger on the inside! Psychologically it seems like your whole world is conveniently on hand when it’s own little kitchen bathroom study and bedroom. Prior to arriving we were A bit worried because the forecast for the weekend was very hot with high 30s predicted but the little cabin is quite cool. In more ways than one! We used the fan to cool the place down overnight and then during the day keep the doors shut and it was fine. Sam and April suggested some great spots by the river to cool off and were great hosts. We will definitely come back again

Grace has been a great host. The accomodation was perfect with all of the facilities needed for a long vacation. The Moubray/Saint Kilda Tram Stop is located just across the road from the building providing easy access into central Melbourne. We had two minor issues with the apartment which were resolved promptly.
Gorgeous and fun play to stay with thoughtful touches and a cosy, dreamy bed. Loved this one so much.

Unbeleivable view from the apartment over the city and out to the harbour and ocean. Location was perfect for everything we wanted. Delicious Vietnamese restaurant downstairs which is perfect for familes. Outlet shopping across the road and Art Gallery and Theatres a short Uber ride away. Would definitely recommend.

My husband, 6yo son, small dog and myself stayed at Siobhan’s place for a week before our recent interstate move. The apartment is cute and cosy with everything you could need included. The beds were incredibly comfortable and the apartment was so quiet which meant for amazing sleeps for everyone. The location is super handy to all the local amenities, and we really felt at home. I could have easily stayed longer and probably will when we’re back in Melbourne for holidays. Siobhan was a great host. We really didn’t need her for anything during our stay as we are locals, but whenever I did have a question she was always quick to respond.
Brigitte and John are wonderful! The property is surrounded by breathtaking hills and the rooms are beautifully set up so touchingly. We will be definitely coming back.
Great location and very responsive hosts. The place is perfect for couples wanting to stay at the city. Very convenient for public transport, also a few dining places and a supermarket nearby!

There is a reason that Brigitte and John have such stellar reviews for their cabin! It was everything you could possibly hope for and then some - a truely gorgeous location, surrounded by great places to eat and visit, two of the most kind and genuine hosts I've had the pleasure of meeting and even a few kangaroos hopping away in the background. We had a wonderful time there and begun planning our next visit before we even left. A truely special place!

The pool is definitely the highlight of this place. The room is neat and the beds were very very comfortable. The shower looked fancy and had a 10 minute limit every 2 hours. But since there’s no aircon in the studio, it got quite warm and stuffy even with the two fans on. There was also limited utensils and we had to go buy some soap and sponges to clean them. We were happy to do that though, and the hosts seemed nice :)
This is a fantastic apartment and we really enjoyed our stay - Brian was really helpful with our reservation changes.
The hosts are very friendly. The house is lovely, especially the garden! We'd love to stay here again and recommend this to our friends.

This apartment is in a fantastic location; the one issue we had was that the bed was quite difficult to sleep on and not as comfy as we would have liked; however, we really enjoyed our stay here and Nick was really helpful. Thank you so much for having us!
Great hosts, location, apartment and great value! I would recommend and I will stay again. Thanks for a great stay.
Lisa’s place was very nice. Everything that she posted is accurate and I really enjoyed my time at her place :)

We absolutely loved this house and would highly recommend staying here. The house was beautiful and exceptionally clean. It had all the comforts of home. It was a beautiful property and very peaceful.

Yolande has created a very special place to stay. It has everything to make a stay very memorable. Well equipped and comfortable. It's quiet with a delightful garden. It's a little oasis with just the birds and bees to keep you company. You will enjoy every moment. Highly recommended.

The Chapel was the most outstanding accommodation I have stayed in for a number of years. The historic building was unique and interesting, situated in a quiet court. The apartment was beautifully fitted out with quality furnishings, comfortable fireside nook, great heating and every conceivable extra we needed. Lovely wide private verandah space looking out over well maintained gardens and lawn. Everything about the Chapel was relaxing and a pleasure to stay in. I cannot recommend this accommodation enough and hope to return again.

Neat little apartment in close proximity to the city. We were able to secure an Uber really quickly to get around and there’s public transport to get in and out of the city. A comfy bed and a quiet stay. Louise also left us some breakfast items in case we wanted to cook up our own bacon and eggs, but there just happens to be a great little cafe less than 60 seconds from the front door that was too good to pass up.
Wonderful accomodation! Very comfortable, amazing communciation and beautiful artwork! It was a very comfortable space!

Lynda's airbnb is in a central location and easy to walk to everything. The styling is so interesting and I loved the special touches such as the teas, coffee, breakfast and the books and magazines. The bed was super comfortable and the under floor heating is so perfect for a cold winter stay in Melbourne.
Great weekend getaway for me, very quiet place while also being close to what you need and only a little away from the nice roads in the dandy’s.

I am a return guest for a reason. Yolande is a terrific host and the cottage has a great feel. I enjoy sitting on the porch with a view of the gardens. It's also a quick walk to the beach and cafes. I've stayed in many Airbnb's and this is one of my favourites
Fantastic stylish space in a great location. Anthony and Cinthya are great hosts, very accommodating and easy to get in touch with. This was my second stay at their place, which I highly recommend.

A very cute cottage set in a beautiful garden. A seperate kitchen area that is fully stocked with everything you need. Yolanda provides a great selection of breakfast options. The bed is super comfy. I always enjoy my stays here.
Stylish and spacious apartment in a great location - vicinity to Chapel St was great! Check in process was flexible and easy.

Shelly was so easy to contact the entirety of the stay at her property. She was so accomodating and lovely to deal with. The house was clean, beautifully styled and the perfect get away Airbnb. Thank you Shelly!
Perfect for our needs for a nearby wedding & close to Sydney St restaurants and shops. Highly recommended if you’re looking for something away from the hussle and bustle of traffic noise.
Over all it is all good. But the price is a little bit of expensive side.
Great for a short stay business trip. Flexible check-in. Walk to most of CBD or tram stops.

One of the rooms faces directly into the sun rising which can get quite hot if you’re staying on a hot day. Had issues with hair on pillows. Also the walls are paper thin with the neighbours so had a bit of a scare thinking someone was in the apartment with me when I thought I was alone. (Can hear neighbours sneeze). Otherwise a great location to stay.

The place was very good but there was a few things we felt could be improved upon which was the person doing the meet and greet was ringing every 5 minutes to see where we were even though we said we would let him know when we were 15 minutes away. The couch and bed are dated and could do with replacement. The positives were that it was close to public transport and the space was functional for a 1br apartment. It had all facilities you would need. We enjoyed the view out over the Yarra river. The apartment was clean and tidy and even had wifi there. Close to coffee shops and cafes and restaraunts. Also close to tram stops to go to queen Victoria markets. And right across the road from the southern cross station. Public transport was a breeze. Would definitely stay here again

Brand new feel at Shiya's place, and it was exactly as we saw on the Airbnb. Spacious, well-appointed and quiet. Comfy beds, super-efficient fridge, massive dining room table and lovely outdoor setting. Shiya was super quick with communication and we experienced no problems at all. Highly recommnded.

Great host, very responsive, helpful. Apartment is spotless clean, breathtaking city views, convenient location, easy check in and check out. This is the second time we have stayed in one of their apartments, will definitely be coming back and highly recommended for anyone who is interested in staying in the Melbourne CBD. Thank you Lee for hosting us again and we will be back :)

The apartment was in a good location for everything we needed to do, free parking was a plus for us, easy check in. The apartment itself is okay, clean, bed comfortable. The apartment is on the older side and a little easy to hear noise from outside but overall happy with the stay

Samantha was terrific to deal with and usually ahead of the game with her communication . Fabulous apartment compact but fabulous fittings and spotlessly clean . I will definitely stay again....very good value

We stayed at the tiny house for our little elopement, which was everything we needed. It was quiet, private, and just right for the two of us. Everything was clean, and its size made us realize how incredible life can be with just the essentials. We connected with nature and enjoyed all its sounds, from crickets and birds to the rustling of some trees. Katherine was also very responsive and went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. She supplied us with some recommendations of things to do in the area, and even left us some treats. If we're ever in town again, I would definitely stay here again.
This place never disappoints! It's a gem in the city giving you great access to the Trams! Having been here before, this 2nd stay gives us good time to enjoy the city lights from the apartment!

We had trouble getting in contact with them to drop our bags off which was a paid extra. We found the water pressure and temp of the showers awful to use. The dinning room chairs are unsafe, you can see they’ve tried to add towels underneath to add support which isn’t working.

We had a peaceful stay at Cosmo Carlton, really enjoyed the cafe's and restaurants nearby, super easy to get the tram service. Look forward to using this groovy little apartment again. Many thanks Greg and Maureen.

Firstly, the apartment was wonderful with an amazing view, amazing facilities and very useful Woolworths downstairs :) Then, all the support team was AMAZING, they always answered fast, try to find a solution, be understanding.. many many thanks for everything!
Excellent location with easy access to public transportation, shopping mall, and restaurants. The flat we were staying in was clean, tidy and fabulous with a fascinating view. Highly recommended
Location, serenity, cleanliness, fung shui. Everything was perfect! Definitely my go to whenever I visit melbourne.
Everything was great, easy check in & check out. Last min wanted parking, & Lee was very responsive in assisting us to it. Defo will come back to stay again. Location was very convenient.

We had a fantastic stay at Lisa’s place. She was very helpful when I had an issue making the booking, and she even accommodated a late check out. The place was clean and heated up nicely. Any of our questions were answered by the house manual on the counter.

Couldn’t recommend staying with Anastasia enough, beautiful space, wonderfully decorated, fairly central and host was amazingly thorough with instructions and super responsive. thanks again for having me, Anastasia!

I enjoyed my stay and it was helpful that it was a hotel because I wanted to store my luggage after I checked out because my flight was in the evening and they were able to hold it for me. Staff were responsive to questions on the app.
Thank you Dora for a lovely stay. It was such a beautiful space with so much greenery!!!
The unit is in a quiet location 10 min drive from the CBD. The unit was clean and tidy with all the comfort to feel like at home. .
